channel.title: DengueCast BD forecasts
channel.description: Weekly dengue hospital admission forecasts for Bangladesh, 1-4 weeks ahead. Planning aid, not an official DGHS warning.

item.title: Bangladesh dengue forecast, week ending 2026-10-31
item.description: Next week (to 2026-10-31) Bangladesh can expect about 11,387 dengue hospital admissions (likely 8,791-14,925; very likely 6,392-27,095). Areas forecast: Barishal division, Chattogram division, Khulna division, Mymensingh division, Bangladesh (national), Rangpur division, Sylhet division. Published late. Details: https://rashed-ahammod.github.io/denguecast-bd/
